title: Hong Kong shares rally as major financial, chip stocks advance at market close
summary: Hang Seng Index closed up 108.09 points (+0.44%) to 24,557.04 on Nov 10, with HK$178B in turnover. HSBC and Standard Chartered rose 4–5%, while Lenovo surged ~6% and AI chip stocks led sector gains. The rally followed Wall Street's strong recovery and sliding oil prices.
why: 港股收市确认情绪回暖，金融股领涨显示资金风险偏好改善。与前日Meituan-6.53%形成反差，今日恒指反弹有利于现有港股多头仓位。注意：本轮大盘头条偏少，前一轮（13:16）已覆盖午评及CPI预告，本轮为收市后运行，新增以收盘数据及美联储官员表态为主。

title: Fed Governor Waller sees December rate hike likely, opens door to 50bps if inflation data surprises
summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said he will support at least a quarter-point rate hike in December, while also opening the door to a half-point move if October core CPI rises 0.3% or more month-on-month. Waller's remarks came ahead of Tuesday's key inflation print.
why: Waller的表态将12月25bp加息基本锁定，同时50bp尾部风险出现。对sell put策略影响直接：CPI今晚21:30发布，若核心CPI环比≥0.3%，科技/成长股隐含波动率可能急升，高行权价put持仓风险上升。配合已有的达拉斯联储鹰派表态（11月7日），美联储整体立场更加明朗。

title: Anthropic pushes ahead with mid-November IPO; roadshow begins week of Nov 9, Nasdaq debut targets Nov 16
summary: Anthropic is proceeding with a mid-November Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT despite some investor skepticism over its valuation. The roadshow began the week of November 9, with pricing expected the week of November 16. The company is targeting a valuation of $1.5T–$2T in what would be one of the largest IPOs in history. SCMP reports the S-1 filing shows explosive revenue growth alongside steep losses and $600B in cloud computing commitments from partners.
why: Anthropic上市是AI大板块里程碑事件：首次给散户和机构提供前沿AI模型公司直接持仓机会；$1.5T-$2T目标估值若成立，将强化整个AI生态的估值锚定——对NVIDIA、Google、腾讯、阿里云均有估值参照意义。Claude与腾讯元宝、阿里千问构成直接竞争，上市后估值差将更清晰。延续报道：本事件自10月26日公开S-1以来持续发酵，本轮为路演启动新进展。
